messages:
Maya: quick sync  final social push plan for the micro-launch. Goals: webinar signups, benchmark narrative, and clean SDR routing for high-intent replies.
Diego: agree. audience split: X for engineers, LinkedIn for PMs/leadership. propose 4-touch cadence: day0 teaser, day2 benchmark thread, day4 webinar push, day6 follow-up + customer quotes.
Priya: I can produce 30s hero + 15s cut, plus a 3-card carousel. need final copy + CTAs by EOD tomorrow. File format: MP4 + 1:1 thumbnails.
Sam: routing note  all webinar CTAs must append utm_source and utm_campaign so Zapier/webhook maps to Webinar_SDR queue. Use exact reply phrases for high-intent triage: "Interested demo" or "Book call". Signups tag = webinar_signup, lead_score=50+. Example CTA: {link}?utm_source=x_social&utm_campaign=may_microlaunch
Maya: good. on creative: graph thumbnail for X (scroll-stopping), product UI for LinkedIn. Priya please include both frames in Figma.
Diego: copy sketches for X (short) and LinkedIn (long):
X-control: "Latency 3x lower, cost 2x lower  the inference moves we shipped. Webinar Thurs 11am PT. Register: {link}?utm_source=x_social&utm_campaign=may_microlaunch"
X-variant: "How we went from prototype to 100k qps: tradeoffs & wins. Demo in our webinar. Register: {link}?utm_source=x_social&utm_campaign=may_microlaunch"
LinkedIn: "How teams ship LLM features reliably: checklist, architecture, and cost playbook. Join our live webinar for a walkthrough. Register: {link}?utm_source=linkedin&utm_campaign=may_microlaunch"
Priya: question on thumbnails  should the graph be annotated with the % improvements? small text might clash on mobile.
Maya: annotate only the headline (e.g., "3x latency") and keep axis labels off thumbnails. full graph goes in carousel.
Sam: I'll run the webhook test today and paste logs. Also adding tweet_id -> intake mapping so SDRs see context for replies. Triage window: 24hrs for flagged replies, then nurture flow.
SchedulerBot: schedule preview created: 4 X posts, 2 LinkedIn posts, 1 carousel, 2 clips. Preview: https://redwood.social/preview/1719993333 :white_check_mark:.
Diego: I'll collect 2 customer micro-quotes for day6. Priya please reserve a slot for customer quote assets.
Maya: paid boost: one X post targeted to developer audiences; one LinkedIn sponsored targeted to PMs. Budget to confirm.
Priya: delivering Figma link shortly.
Sam: webhook test -> 200 OK; sample payload posted to #eng-infra. Routing to Webinar_SDR confirmed.
Maya: next steps: Diego finalize copy by tomorrow 11am, Priya assets by EOD, Sam confirm webhook mapping + test log, final sign-off 9:30am PT tomorrow. Thanks team! :tada:
